steps.rule: Load the verified collapsed pair-year source without modifying it.
Validate foreign partner, supplier direction, binary activity, year range, and unique pair-year keys.
Construct the coverage-qualified firm universe and enumerate all ticker mappings to the firm-year panel.
Create frozen 2017-2019 readiness exposure without using later years.
Construct transition risk sets and the six outcome definitions exactly as registered.
Merge verified pre-policy size and industry fields using an enumerated mapping; retain unmatched counts in the log.
Write firm_year.parquet and validation tables only after all assertions pass.

exclusion_policy: No exclusion may depend on a coefficient, standard error, p-value, or desired sign.
